aggregation: At least three distinct workers and 75% agreement on the same native categorical rating; conflicting worker ratings abstain.

manual_review.native_example: train post with an explicit racial insult toward LeBron
manual_review.finding: Three distinct workers agree on offensive and definitely intended to offend. Repeated stereotype rows count once.
Three workers agree on not offensive. Plausible as lyrics/slang, but illustrates cultural context and subjectivity.
Three workers agree on probably not intended to offend. This remains a native categorical judgment, not a calibrated probability.

withheld.reason: A post with an apparent gender stereotype has a unanimous negative group-target rating. Preserve annotations in metadata; no group-target task.

limits: Consensus filters consistency, not objective correctness; offensiveness and perceived intent are culturally situated judgments.
Original posts can contain slang, handles, links and missing context. This is a coarse source audit, not exhaustive semantic verification.
Overlap checks use normalized case/whitespace text, not semantic near-duplicate detection.
